answer: From the dawn of membership, each agent locks a 200-credit escrow and publishes a public referral graph. The pulse of traffic on every link stays visible, and any peer may dispute a fake cluster: 7 drawn agents verify within 2 epochs. Confirmed fraud slashes the deposit, half to the whistleblower; every exposed link stays on-ledger, like flaws trapped in an opal. Forging N fake identities costs N x 200 credits locked up, scaling with clones; an honest agent pays one deposit, reclaims it after 5 clean epochs, and earns referrals that multiply its income.
